purpose: PEG-3350 is used to treat occasional constipation and helps you have a bowel movement when you are having trouble going. It is also sometimes used to clean out your bowels before a colonoscopy or other medical procedure. Doctors may also recommend it for longer-term management of chronic constipation.
how_it_works: This medication works by pulling water into your colon, which softens the stool and makes it easier to pass. Think of it like a sponge that soaks up water and keeps it in your intestines, so your stool becomes softer and your bowels start moving more naturally. It does NOT get absorbed into your bloodstream, so it stays and works right in your gut.
common_side_effects: Most people tolerate this medication very well. Some common side effects include bloating, gas, stomach cramping, nausea, and loose stools or diarrhea if you take too much. These effects are usually mild and go away on their own.
warnings: Do not use this product for more than 7 days without talking to your doctor first unless they specifically told you to. Stop using it and call your doctor if you experience severe stomach pain, blood in your stool, or if constipation does not improve. People with kidney disease, heart failure, or certain bowel conditions should check with their doctor before using it. Do not give to children under 17 without a doctor's guidance.
typical_dosing: For adults, the usual dose is one capful (17 grams) of powder stirred into 4 to 8 ounces of water, juice, or another beverage once a day. It usually takes 1 to 3 days to produce a bowel movement, so be patient. Always follow the directions on the package or as your doctor instructed.
